videos.title: 越南河內 🇻🇳 交通攻略+住宿指南+12個必去的地方！Hanoi: Transportation Guide + Accommodation Guide + 12 Must-Visit Places
videos.summary: 影片提到河内、Noi Bai Airport、老城區等地點。
videos.description:
这期「帆看世界」主要和大家分享越南河内旅游的行前攻略，内容涵盖三大重点：交通、住宿与必去的地方。视频中详细解析了如何从河内内排机场到市区的多种交通方式，包括86路机场大巴、17路普通公交以及越南航空的Minibus等，并推荐了实用的本地交通APP如Vbus和Busmap Hanoi。住宿方面，同时比较了Agoda、Booking、Airbnb三大平台的青旅和民宿价格，帮你找到性价比最高的住宿。最后，带你走进河内12大必去景点，包括老城区（三十六古街）、火车咖啡街、还剑湖、文庙、胡志明陵、一柱寺、升龙皇城、西湖（真武观+镇国寺）、火炉监狱博物馆、龙边桥、同春市场等，每个景点均附真实游客评价与实用贴士。无论你是第一次来越南，还是想深度探索河内，这期视频都能为你提供实用参考！🍀 This video shares a super detailed pre-trip guide to Hanoi, Vietnam, covering three key areas: transportation, accommodation, and must-see places. The video details various transportation options from Noi Bai Airport to the city center, including airport bus route 86, regular bus route 17, and Vietnam Airlines' minibus, and recommends useful local transportation apps such as Vbus and Busmap Hanoi. Regarding accommodation, it compares hostel and guesthouse prices on Agoda, Booking, and Airbnb to help you find the best value. Finally, it takes you through 12 must-see attractions in Hanoi, including the Old Quarter (36 Ancient Streets), Train Cafe Street, Hoan Kiem Lake, Temple of Literature, Ho Chi Minh Mausoleum, One Pillar Pagoda, Thang Long Imperial City, West Lake (Tran Vu Temple + Tran Quoc Pagoda), Hoa Lo Prison Museum, Long Bien Bridge, and Dong Xuan Market. Each attraction includes real tourist reviews and practical tips. Whether it's your first time in Vietnam or you want to explore Hanoi more deeply, this video will provide you with useful information!
